text: dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim 是 DSH web 的适配插件，把 dsh-cockpit-bridge 的远程编辑器服务接入 dsh-worktree-session。两端服务同时可用时，它注册工作树路径处理器，并在服务变化时重新连接；用户触发编辑器打开后，绝对路径会转交 Cockpit bridge，在远程机器打开。任一服务缺失时不连接，卸载时清理监听与注册。适用于远程工作树编辑场景，需安装 bridge、Worktree Session，并在宿主机配置 VS Code Remote-SSH。

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim connects the Cockpit remote editor to Worktree Session in DSH web. When both services are available, it registers a handler to forward worktree paths for remote opening and reconnects as services change. Requires both endpoint plugins and VS Code Remote-SSH.
想让远程 worktree 的打开操作进入 Cockpit 上的 VS Code。
DSH web 能不能把工作树路径交给远程编辑器打开？
How can I open a remote worktree in the Cockpit editor from DSH?
dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim 的功能「远程打开工作树」：注册路径处理器，将用户触发打开操作时收到的绝对路径原样交给 Cockpit 编辑器服务。

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim：English · [简体中文](README.zh.md)

<!-- problem -->
Without this shim, the "open in editor" action of a Worktree Session on a remote machine falls back to a local `vscode://file/` link that cannot reach the worktree. The shim hands the worktree path to dsh-cockpit's remote-editor capability so the editor opens on the right machine.

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim：A deployment-side adapter: it registers the remote-editor open capability exposed by `dsh-cockpit-bridge` into the generic open-behaviour extension point of `dsh-worktree-session`.

```text
dsh-cockpit-bridge ──provide──▶ shim ──register──▶ dsh-worktree-session
  knows nothing about ws                     knows nothing about cockpit
```

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · Install：Install it next to both ends: [dsh-cockpit-bridge](https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-cockpit) >= 0.4.0 (distributed as a GitHub Release tarball) and `dsh-worktree-session`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/prgrmrwy/dsh-cockpit/releases/download/dsh-cockpit-bridge-v0.6.4/dsh-cockpit-bridge-0.6.4.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim
```

Then restart DSH web. Uninstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim`.

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · Why a separate package：Worktree Session is a generic plugin and must not know about dsh-cockpit; dsh-cockpit-bridge must not know its concrete consumers either. All coupling between the two ends lives only in this shim, which keeps independent upgrades and complete removal possible.

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · Behaviour：- No top-level `inject`; at runtime it watches both services appearing and disappearing, so any load order works.
- It reads the bridge service by the full dotted name `ctx.get('cockpitBridge.editorOpen')`; `ctx.get('cockpitBridge').editorOpen` is forbidden.
- It forwards only the absolute worktree path, unchanged, to the bridge: no validation, no rewriting, no state, no retries.
- If either end is missing or unloaded, the shim is inert; Worktree Session automatically falls back to its default `vscode://file/` behaviour.

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · Prerequisites and known limits：- Requires `dsh-cockpit-bridge >= 0.4.0` (this repository currently pins 0.6.4); an older bridge does not provide the service and the shim silently does nothing.
- The host machine needs VS Code Remote-SSH installed and must be able to reach the target device through the SSH config alias registered for the Cockpit device.
- Without Remote-SSH the URI may be silently dropped; a directory name containing a dot may be treated as a file by the VS Code URI handler.

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · Removal：<!-- section: removal -->
This shim connects two ends: the **`cockpitBridge.editorOpen` service** of `dsh-cockpit-bridge` and the **open-behaviour extension point** (`worktreeSession.openHandler`) of `dsh-worktree-session`. Neither side references the other, so the shim is the only place the two meet.

dsh-cockpit-worktree-open-shim README · Removal：It can be removed at any time, and it should be removed once you stop using dsh-cockpit remote editors, or when either end ships the integration natively. Delete or disable `cockpit-worktree-open-shim` in `dsh.yaml`, run `dsh build`, and restart DSH web. After removal:
